questions.question: What’s the benefit of two-factor authentication?

options.text: A password alone isn’t enough to get into your account
options.explanation: Correct. Your phone is needed too, so a stolen password isn’t enough on its own.
Signing in gets one extra step. In return, your account is much better protected.

options.text: Without it you can’t use GitHub at all
options.explanation: The main reason isn’t that it’s required, it’s your account’s security.

options.text: They get you into your account if you lose your phone
options.explanation: Exactly. Keep them in a safe place somewhere other than your phone.

options.text: They replace your password every time you sign in
options.explanation: Recovery codes are a backup for emergencies, not for everyday use.

options.text: They aren’t needed, you can skip them
options.explanation: Without recovery codes, a lost phone can mean losing access to your account.
